question: What is the average speed of a car that covers half the distance at the speed of 84 km/hr and the other half at the speed of 63 km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed for two equal halves = 2v₁v₂ / (v₁ + v₂)

Average Speed = (2 × 84 × 63) / (84 + 63)

Average Speed = 10584 / 147 = 72 km/hr

**∴ Answer = 72 km/hr**
